**Fixes**
- Brutal Sports Football: no more black boxes around the mud marks. The blitter's transparency now uses the game's chosen "transparent colour" instead of always zero.
- Worms: the title screen is clean (no noise band or broken logo) and the bottom WIND bar is fixed. Zero-width blits wrote 65,536 pixels instead of one.
- Syndicate: main menu text is no longer garbled.
- Low-colour sprites (1, 2 and 4 bits per pixel) now pick their palette colours the way the hardware does.

**New**
- Settings > Display > Crop overscan (on by default): hides the outer border a TV would cut off. Fixes the coloured junk along the bottom of Super Burnout and players walking past the edge of the field in Troy Aikman NFL Football.

**Please re-test**
- Phase Zero and Zero 5: both play normally on my side with this version.

**Known issues**
- Power Drive Rally: still a black screen.
- AvP Marine campaign doors: still being looked at.
